notes: P8-B official spatial hazard layer v1. Tokyo Open Data tsunami 10m mesh CSV resources from Tokyo Metropolitan Government damage-estimation tsunami datasets were clipped to the official MLIT N03 Chuo City polygon. 東京都「首都直下地震等による東京の被害想定」 is the broader source-family/report context; the actual extracted tsunami spatial layers are 大正関東地震 and 南海トラフ巨大地震 case 1. No 都心南部直下地震 tsunami inundation-depth, arrival-time, or tsunami-height layer is extracted or claimed. Maximum inundation depth is spatially extracted from tsunami CSVs, not Chuo flood proxy data. Maximum tsunami height remains a separate height field. The derived boundary is a grid extent bbox, not an official inundation contour. No P8-D damage/collapse or P9 gameplay behavior is implemented by this layer.
